confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'indicates a serious internal electrical fault, likely a short circuit in the high-voltage components or the door interlock system'

rationale: The assistant gave the correct stop-use, unplug, stop-resetting and do-not-open advice, and pointed to an engineer, with the door interlock named as a likely cause. It asked no questions, such as whether the RCD stays set with the microwave unplugged, whether it trips on another circuit, or whether an extension lead is in use. It also did not suggest replacing a cheap unit, and it was somewhat long and repetitive. It also leaned on 'main fuse' wording and said 'serious internal fault' with moderate certainty, though it hedged with 'likely'. Overall it is safe and appropriate but lacks the follow-up that would have made it more useful.
